name: Cicero's Hoard
purpose: A local workspace that turns a brief and source documents into an editable presentation: outline, slides with speaker notes, per-slide review and revisions, themes, and export to PPTX (native text and charts), PDF, HTML and Markdown, for assistants over MCP.
notes: Keep the app running (python -m cicero_hoard): the MCP bridge proxies every call to the local server, never opens the database, and starts the app itself when it is not answering. Tools that change or delete something: deck_create, deck_update, deck_delete, source_add, source_remove, outline_generate, outline_update, slides_generate, slide_update, slide_regenerate, slide_approve, slide_revert, slide_add, slide_delete, slides_reorder, slides_add, slide_edit_text, slide_set_image, asset_import, deck_template, deck_theme (with a theme), theme_from_tokens (saves a theme and can apply it), deck_export (writes a file), slide_image, craft_call (runs native VectorCraft or DesignCraft commands), vector_figure_create (adds an editable SVG figure to a slide), deck_handout_designcraft (writes an editable document and PNG previews). Deletes need confirm=true and only when the user asks; outline_generate, outline_update and slides_generate replace what the outline or the draft slides held. Approving a slide is the person's decision. PDF export needs Chromium (python -m playwright install chromium); without it deck_export with format pdf fails with pdf_unavailable and the other formats still work. Configure CICERO_VECTORCRAFT_CLI and CICERO_DESIGNCRAFT_CLI to enable their local MCP tools.
